action: Collect existing public rational and dispatch traces across all eight quadratic fixture families and all four original construction/first/warm/cloned phases.
reuse: Link a separate diagnostic driver against the three already built release rlibs. Do not rebuild or edit library sources.
schedule: Two fresh processes per variant, each with the original 4096 inputs and complete eight-family order; all six runs retained. Build all three diagnostic executables before running.
witnesses: Keep the original fixture, mathematical expected-value and witness code byte-identical. Check all exact coefficients and compare every witness/representation row with both closed library trials at the same input count.
limits: Trace counts are diagnostics, not elapsed cost or allocation measurements. Existing trace labels do not count every cache copy/lock/allocation; unchanged counts cannot establish unchanged performance.
